name: Point Cloud Reconstruction from 2D Slices
definition: A method to reconstruct a 3D shell/point cloud from a series of 2D image slices by extracting boundary points from binary masks and assigning them depth coordinates.
summary: Point Cloud Reconstruction from 2D Slices creates a sparse 3D surface shell from aligned 2D slices, differing from volumetric voxelization by prioritizing memory efficiency over volume density.
